create_video_feature: create a Video feature to read video data from a file path in a HuggingFace dataset
encode_video_example: encode a video file path or bytes into an Arrow-compatible dictionary with path and bytes fields
decode_video_example: decode a stored video example into a torchcodec VideoDecoder object for frame access
cast_video_storage: cast a PyArrow string or binary array into the Video struct storage type with bytes and path fields
embed_video_storage: embed local or remote video file bytes into a PyArrow struct array by reading the files
